extracted.intended_audience: CIA directorates and office budget/reporting staff (e.g., Directors of Communications, Finance, Logistics, Medical Services, Personnel, Security, Training)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting internal CIA reports implementing OMB Circular A-44 (Revised) per memorandum instructions, including required sections, deadlines, coverage periods, and budget scope restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report timing and coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: The first report to be submitted to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff no later than 21 December 1970 should include nothing at all regarding FY 1970 and covers the period of time between 1 January and 30 June 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This initial report is necessary because the data was not included when the last budget went forward. Only Sections I and II are to be included in this initial report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that Section I, 'Management Effectiveness Goals,' and Section II, 'Cost Reduction Goals,' are the only sections to be included in the initial report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include Sections III/IV (if any) in the initial submission; limit content to the two specified sections for the Jan–Jun 1971 period.

rubrics_metrics.name: First full report timing and coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: The first full report will be submitted so as to reach the Executive Director–Comptroller on 30 June 1971 and will cover the period 1 July 1971 – 30 June 1972.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The full report submitted by 30 June 1971 must contain all four sections (i.e., the complete set of required report sections).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope limited to own office budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Your reports should be limited to your own Office's budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This limitation is necessary to avoid confusion as to who claims what savings; do not report or claim savings attributable to other offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of standardized form and instructions (forthcoming)
rubrics_metrics.description: A form and set of instructions will be prepared for the 30 June 1971 report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait for and use the uniform form/instructions when issued for the 30 June 1971 full report; current reporting may lack uniformity until that guidance is provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aspirational integration with normal budget submittals
rubrics_metrics.description: It is hoped that the reporting instructions can, at some future date, be modified to permit inclusion of the information called for in the annual report in the normal budget 'submittals.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a stated objective for future process change; current reports should follow the memorandum's separate reporting schedule until integration occurs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referenced deadline from prior memorandum
rubrics_metrics.description: This amends our memorandum, same subject, dated 13 November 1970. The deadline remains 14 December 1970.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note there is a referenced earlier deadline (14 December 1970) from the previous memorandum—confirm which deadline applies to your specific deliverable (this memo also cites 21 December 1970 for submission to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff).

rubrics_metrics.name: Document classification marking practice (routing slip)
rubrics_metrics.description: SENDER WILL CHECK CLASSIFICATION TOP AND BOTTOM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing routing slips or related transmittals, ensure classification appears at both top and bottom of the page per routing-slip instructions.
